purpose: Identify completed abandonment-to-recolonization cycles in stable SMP breeding SiteIDs using only explicit zero/positive count states, before any abundance magnitude is used.

vacancy_spell.abandonment: occupied in complete calendar year t and explicit zero in t+1
vacancy_spell.recolonization: after one or more consecutive explicit-zero complete years, first later complete calendar year with count > 0
vacancy_spell.completeness: every retained SiteID must be observed in every year used by the spell under the frozen panel roster
vacancy_spell.no_gap_rule: every year from abandonment transition through recolonization transition must be calendar-consecutive and complete; do not bridge an unobserved year
vacancy_spell.multiple_spells: allowed; all qualifying completed spells retained
vacancy_spell.first_colonization: not part of the primary test because no within-site abandonment threshold exists to pair against it

allowed_outputs_before_magnitudes: number of completed spells by site/panel/species

decision.if_passed: Freeze the exact completed-spell roster and authorize one magnitude-opening hysteresis execution.
decision.if_failed: Stop the hysteresis route. Do not lower cycle-count, species, SiteID, MasterSite or gap thresholds.
